priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect at all times.
Use Evocation if mana is below 10% and your major cooldowns (Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi) are not active.
Cast Touch of the Magi immediately after Arcane Surge, or if Surge is on cooldown for more than 30 seconds.
Use offensive trinkets and racial buffs during your Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi window.
Cast Arcane Orb if you have fewer than 4 Arcane Charges to quickly build resources in AoE.
Cast Arcane Barrage when you have 4 Arcane Charges and Arcane Salvo has reached 20 stacks.
Cast Arcane Barrage at the end of an Arcane Surge or Touch of the Magi window if you have 15 or more Arcane Salvo stacks.
Cast Arcane Orb immediately after an Arcane Barrage if Orb Mastery is talented to reset charges.
Cast Arcane Missiles with Clearcasting to build Arcane Salvo stacks, but prioritize other actions if Salvo is already at 15 or more stacks.
Use Presence of Mind to quickly reach 4 Arcane Charges with Arcane Blast when your other charge generators are on cooldown.
Cast Arcane Pulse (if talented) whenever 3 or more enemies are present.
Cast Arcane Blast as your filler spell to generate Arcane Charges when Orb is unavailable.
Cast Arcane Barrage to dump charges in AoE situations if you are not in a cooldown window and have no Salvo stacks to build.
Use Counterspell to interrupt dangerous enemy casts.
